title: VistaTree: Question Answering over Long Multimodal Documents with Image-Derived Summary Trees
abstract: arXiv:2611.29419v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Answering questions over long multimodal documents requires locating relevant evidence across pages containing text, tables, and figures. When the document exceeds the model's context window, selective retrieval becomes necessary. We introduce VistaTree, a document question-answering agent that builds a summary tree directly from rendered page images. VistaTree segments documents into contiguous page spans, recursively groups them into a topic hierarchy, and refines sibling summaries to distinguish neighboring sections. At query time, the agent uses node summaries to select relevant nodes and reads the corresponding pages, using hierarchical navigation when the full outline exceeds the context budget. Experiments on MMLongBench-Doc and LongDocURL evaluate answer quality and retrieval cost using a locally hosted vision-language model, and quantify the performance gap between global and hierarchical access to the index.

translated_title: VistaTree：基于图像导出摘要树的长篇多模态文档问答
translated_abstract: 对长篇多模态文档进行问答需要在包含文本、表格和图表的页面中定位相关证据。当文档超出模型的上下文窗口时，就需要进行选择性检索。我们提出了VistaTree，这是一个文档问答智能体，它直接从渲染的页面图像构建摘要树。VistaTree将文档分割为连续的页面片段，递归地将它们组织成主题层次结构，并细化兄弟节点摘要以区分相邻章节。在查询时，该智能体使用节点摘要来选择相关节点并阅读对应页面，当完整大纲超出上下文预算时则采用层次化导航。在MMLongBench-Doc和LongDocURL数据集上的实验使用本地部署的视觉-语言模型评估了答案质量和检索成本，并量化了对索引进行全局访问与层次化访问之间的性能差距。
tldr: VistaTree通过直接从页面图像构建层次化摘要树并进行层级导航，实现了对超出上下文窗口的长篇多模态文档的高效问答。
en_tdlr: VistaTree enables efficient question answering over long multimodal documents that exceed the context window by building hierarchical summary trees directly from page images with hierarchical navigation.
